Implemented the "Home Screen A" control-room redesign for the session-manager Home tab, adapted from the design mock to use only real, wired data (no fabricated charts/breakdowns):

**Changed:** `src/renderer/components/tabs/Home.tsx`
- **Hero**: `This machine · N projects` kicker, headline shows real session-slot usage plus a clickable "needs you" count that jumps to the new section; added `All history` / `New epic` header actions.
- **New "Needs you" section**: surfaces three real, already-existing human-gate signals — `proposed` Epics (Approve & start / Discard, reusing `EpicApprovalBar`'s logic), chat tickets stuck on `needs-input` (Open session), and scheduler jobs in `failed`/`needs_review` (Retry now / View in Scheduler). Rows expand inline, matching the design's interaction pattern.
- **New `QueuedCard`**: shows real pending scheduler jobs (title, project, estimate) as the third column alongside the existing Usage and Projects cards.
- Left the Active/Recent sessions cards and Agents card as-is (already real-data and functionally aligned with the design).

**New:** `src/renderer/lib/homeNeedsYou.ts` — pure, dependency-free join helper (`buildNeedsYouRows`) plus `src/renderer/lib/__tests__/homeNeedsYou.test.ts` (5 tests, all passing).

Deliberately **not** implemented from the mock: the fabricated 14-day pace sparkline and per-project token-% breakdown — no real data source backs either, and the project's grounding-board rule ("never fabricated placeholder numbers") rules that out.

Verified: `npm run typecheck` clean, `npm run lint:selectors` clean, full `vitest run` — 2107/2107 passing.

## Summary

Removed **Repo Viz** and **Search** from the Tools section of the Left Navigation (Project tab), and deleted all related code end-to-end:

**Nav/routing:**
- `LeftNav.tsx` — removed `'repoviz'`/`'search'` from the `NavKey` union
- `navGroups.ts` — removed both entries from `NAV_ITEMS` (Voice remains, home-face only)
- `screenKeys.ts`, `screenComponents.tsx` — removed from `SCREEN_KEYS`, page-meta, and the render switch
- `AlmanacSidebar.tsx` — trimmed `ToolKey`; the "Tools" group header/rows now only render when non-empty (previously it would've shown an empty "Tools" header on the Project face, since Voice is home-only)
- `AlmanacIcon.tsx` — removed the now-dead `'repoviz'` and `'global-search'` icon variants (kept `'search'`, still used by AddressBar/FindBar/SchedulePanel)
- `CommandPalette.tsx`, `slashCommand.ts`, `learningContent.ts` — removed the corresponding palette entries, `/repoviz` `/repo` `/search` slash routes, and Learn-panel content blocks

**Behavior:**
- `App.tsx` — removed the `⌘P`/`⌘⇧F` global shortcuts, `searchMode` state, and the now-unneeded search-input carve-out in the key-skip logic
- `Workbench.tsx` — dropped the `ctx.searchMode` re-mount dependency

**Deleted files:** `RepoVisualizationModal.tsx`, `SearchModal.tsx`, `GlobalSearchModal.tsx`, `QuickOpenModal.tsx`, `main/repoAnalyzer.cjs`, `main/search.cjs`, `tests/e2e/search-mode-toggle.spec.ts`

**Backend:** `main/index.cjs` (dropped requires + IPC registration), `preload/index.cjs` and `preload/api.d.ts` (dropped the `search`/`repo` API namespaces and their now-orphaned types: `SearchFileEntry`, `SearchFilesResult`, `SearchTextMatch`, `SearchTextResult`, `RepoLanguageStats`, `RepoTopDirectory`, `RepoGitStatusSummary`, `RepoAnalyzeResult`, `RepoAnalyzeError`)

**Tests updated** (not just deleted where behavior changed): `AlmanacSidebar.test.ts` (added a test proving Tools is hidden on the project face and still shows Voice on home), `navGroupsHome.test.ts`, `slashCommand.test.ts…

Committed as `1d87b3a` on `main`: 24 files changed (546 insertions, 2068 deletions). This covers both the Home page control-room redesign and the Repo Viz/Search removal — the two pieces of work from this session.

Left unstaged/uncommitted: the `session-manager-operations/` state files and the `Hooks/McpServers/Permissions/Settings/Skills/SystemPrompt` tab + `layout.ts` changes, since those belong to a different, concurrently-running agent's in-progress work on this repo — not something I touched or should sweep into this commit. Not pushed, per standing instructions (push/publish needs its own trigger).

Both PRDs are correctly written and filed. Here's the summary of this turn's work.

## Diagnosis

I compared your screenshot against the real committed code (v0.58.0, confirmed as the actual bundled build the running Electron process — PID 2908481, launched 19:55 today — is serving; `dist/assets/*.js` does contain the "Needs you"/"This machine" strings, so the code is genuinely deployed). Two real gaps explain the mismatch:

1. **The "Queued" card region rendered blank** in your screenshot — third column, no header/border visible at all. That's either a real bug (store snapshot not yet arrived when the card first mounts) or a rendering quirk — worth a proper regression test either way.
2. **I never built the mock's richer interaction layer** — the "Interactions" legend toggle, and the Active/Recent session rows opening a slide-in detail drawer (the mock's `ADrawer`) instead of just firing a flat action. Those are the parts that make the mock *feel* like a distinct "control room" rather than a plain card list, so their absence is likely the biggest reason it reads as "doesn't look at all like the design."

I deliberately did **not** rebuild the mock's "Pace" sparkline or per-project token-% breakdown — both use entirely fabricated numbers in the mock (a hardcoded 14-day array, "3.19M tokens", "87% by Thursday"), and this app has no real per-project token-attribution data source to back that honestly.

## Action taken

Rather than hand-patch this again inline, I decomposed the remaining gap into two PRDs and queued them to the existing Epic (`psess-msch6x36-16`, this same "Home Page" Epic), per your "Execute the PRD decomposition" instruction:

- **PRD 966** — diagnose+fix the blank Queued card with a permanent jsdom regression test, add the real (non-fabricated) Interactions legend toggle.
- **PRD 967** — build the real slide-in `HomeSessionDrawer` for Active/Recent session rows (depends on 966), backed only by data this app actually has; Fork/Export buttons only wir…

Done. Set `model: fable` on the `dev-lead` persona (`~/.claude/agents/dev-lead.md`) — since this Epic's `agentType` is `dev-lead`, resuming this Epic's Chat/Terminal session will now launch with `--model fable` per `resolveEpicModel`.

Two things worth flagging so this does what you expect:

1. **This is global, not scoped to just this Epic.** `dev-lead.md` is the one shared persona definition — every Epic anywhere on this machine that uses `agentType: dev-lead` will now launch on Fable too, not just this "Home Page" Epic. There's no per-Epic model override separate from the persona it points at.
2. **It does not touch PRD 966/967 execution.** I need to correct something from my last summary — I'd said PRD execution model comes from the Epic's persona, but that's wrong: `scheduler.cjs` hardcodes `--model sonnet` for every scheduled PRD job regardless of any persona's `model` field (`resolveEpicModel` only governs the Epic's own live Chat/Terminal session, not scheduler jobs). So the queued PRDs will still run on Sonnet no matter what — which matches what you said ("scheduler dev-lead is good"), just wanted to be precise about *why* that's unaffected rather than let the earlier wrong claim stand.

Takes effect on the next resume of this Epic's session (this turn is already running under whatever model launched it).

Yes — decomposition is now complete, and most of it has already shipped. Status of the full Home Screen A design against the codebase:

**Already landed (committed):**
- Hero (kicker, slots-busy greeting, "N things need you" jump link, All history / New epic buttons), Needs-you section, Usage meters, Projects card, Active/Recent sessions — `1d87b3a` (this session's first pass)
- PRD 966 → `8a3e979`: QueuedCard empty-state fix + Interactions legend toggle
- PRD 967 → `fcb4180`: real slide-in session detail drawer for Active/Recent rows (the mock's ADrawer pattern)

**Just queued (final piece):**
- PRD 973 `home-queued-popover-new-epic-picker` — the last two real-data-backed mock interactions: the Queued card's per-job popover, and the New-epic project-picker drawer (reusing 967's drawer primitive). Pending in the queue now; dev-lead persona carries `model: fable` as you set up, though note scheduler PRD jobs themselves still pin `--model sonnet` in `scheduler.cjs`.

**Deliberately excluded, never to be decomposed** (documented in Home.tsx's header): the mock's Pace sparkline and Usage per-project breakdown — both run on fabricated numbers (hardcoded 14-day array, invented token splits) with no real data source in this app, and the project rule is real-data-only. "Skip next" on queued jobs is likewise excluded — no per-job skip API exists to back it.

Once 973 completes, every element of Home Screen A that can be honestly backed by real app data will be implemented.

Verified — audited every visual on the Home dashboard against its data source. **Everything currently shipped is built on existing APIs/stores; zero fabricated values.** Here's the full accounting:

| Visual | Data source (existing API/store) |
|---|---|
| Hero slot count ("N of M slots busy") | `window.api.schedule.sessionSlots()` — live slot pool, polled 5s |
| Hero "N things need you" | Derived from the three real stores below via `homeNeedsYou.ts` |
| Usage meters (Session 5h / Weekly / Opus / Sonnet / extra usage) | `useBilling` → the real `/api/oauth/usage` billing endpoint |
| Projects card (names, live counts, last activity) | `useKnownProjects` (real `~/.claude/projects` scan) + running chats join |
| Queued card | `useScheduleState` snapshot — real scheduler queue.json jobs |
| Needs-you rows | `usePromptSessions` (proposed Epics), `useChat` ticketHistory (needs-input), scheduler jobs (failed/needs_review); actions wired to real `approveProposed`/`markCompleted`/`send`/`resetJob` |
| Active sessions + drawer | `sessionSlots()` holders joined to real jobs/chats; drawer KeyVals (owner/kind/Epic/project/started) all from store state; live tail = **real** last 4 chat turns from `useChat` — shown only for running chat runs, omitted otherwise (no placeholder) |
| Recent sessions + drawer | Real transcript scan via `window.api.config.listDir` (same source as History tab); Resume = real `claude --resume`; drawer shows only real id/project/mtime/size — the mock's invented "$4.10 est." and turn counts were **not** carried over |
| Interactions legend | Static reference copy describing only interactions that actually exist |
| Slot cap slider | `window.api.schedule.setSessionSlots()` |

Mock elements with **no backing API were excluded, not faked**: Pace sparkline, per-project token split, "Skip next", Fork/Export (no backend actions exist) — all documented in Home.tsx's header comment. Grep for fabricated literals (`$`, "est. cost", "3.19M", spark arrays, placeholde…

Pushed. `main` is now synced with origin (`591428b..ca3d82a`, 8 commits, 0 ahead/0 behind).

What went up includes all the completed Home Screen A work — the control-room dashboard (`1d87b3a`, pushed earlier in that range's history), PRD 966's QueuedCard fix + Interactions legend (`8a3e979`), PRD 967's session detail drawer (`fcb4180`) — plus concurrent work from other Epics on this machine (Epics agent/mission changes, project-pages "brief" lens, ops state syncs).

One thing is deliberately *not* "all done": **PRD 973** (Queued-job popover + New-epic project picker, the final fidelity piece) is still `pending` in the scheduler queue — it hasn't executed yet. When it completes it will commit locally per the scheduler's flow, but that future commit won't push itself; it'll be included next time you push or publish.

function AMeter({ label, tag, pct, note, color }) {

  </div>;

function ASpark({ data, w = 280, h = 44, color, mode }) {
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  if (mode === 'bars') {
    const bw = w / data.length;
    return <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" height={h} style={{ display: 'block', width: '100%' }}>
      {data.map((v, i) => <rect key={i} x={i * bw + 1} y={h - (v / max) * (h - 3)} width={bw - 2.5} height={(v / max) * (h - 3)} rx="1.5" fill={i === data.length - 1 ? A.accent : A.accent + '66'} />)}
    </svg>;
  }
  const step = w / (data.length - 1);
  const pts = data.map((v, i) => `${(i * step).toFixed(1)},${(h - (v / max) * (h - 4)).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
  return <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" height={h} style={{ display: 'block', width: '100%' }}>
    <polyline points={`0,${h} ${pts} ${w},${h}`} fill={(color || A.accent) + '22'} stroke="none" />
    <polyline points={pts} fill="none" stroke={color || A.accent} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinejoin="round" />
  </svg>;
}

              </div>
            </div>; })()}

        <div id="a-needs">
          <ASection title="Needs you" right={needs.length ? `${needs.length} open` : 'all clear'} gap={7}>
            {needs.length === 0 && <div style={{ ...aCard, padding: '18px 16px', textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 13, color: A.inkMute }}>Nothing waiting on you. Sessions will surface here when they block.</div>}
            {needs.map(n => { const open = openNeed === n.id; return <div key={n.id} style={{ background: open ? A.card : A.paper, border: `1px solid ${open ? A.edge : A.rule}`, borderRadius: 11, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
              <button onClick={() => setOpenNeed(open ? null : n.id)} style={{ ...bare, width: '100%', display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '6px minmax(0,1fr) auto auto', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center', padding: '10px 13px' }}>
                <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', background: aTone[n.tone] }} />
                <span style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 600, color: A.ink }}>{n.label}</span>
                  <span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: 11.5, color: A.inkMute, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{n.detail}</span>
                </span>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: A.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: A.inkMute }}>{n.when}</span>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: A.mono, fontSize: 11, color: A.inkMute }}>{open ? '▴' : '▾'}</span>
              </button>
              {open && <div style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${A.rule}`, padding: '11px 13px 12px', display: 'grid', gap: 10 }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: A.inkSoft, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>{n.meta}</div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                  <AButton onClick={() => resolve(n.id, `${n.actions[0]} — done`)}>{n.actions[0]}</AButton>
                  <AButton kind="quiet" onClick={() => resolve(n.id, `${n.actions[1]} — done`)}>{n.actions[1]}</AButton>
                  <AButton style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }} onClick={() => resolve(n.id, 'Dismissed')}>Dismiss</AButton>
                </div>
              </div>}
            </div>; })}
          </ASection>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)', gap: 20 }}>
          <ASection title="Active sessions" right="3 of 3 slots">
            {A_ACTIVE.map(s => <button key={s.id} onClick={() => setDrawer({ type: 'session', data: s })} style={{ ...bare, ...aCard, padding: '12px 15px', display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(0,1fr) auto', gap: 14, alignItems: 'center', width: '100%' }}>
              <span style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9, marginBottom: 4 }}>
                  <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', background: A.accent }} />
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: A.mono, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: A.ink, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{s.name}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: A.mono, fontSize: 10, color: A.inkMute, flexShrink: 0 }}>{s.kind}</span>
                </span>
                <span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: 11.5, color: A.inkMute }}>{s.project} · {s.for}</span>
              </span>
              <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: A.mono, fontSize: 11, color: A.inkSoft }}>{s.tokens}</span>

                <span style={{ fontFamily: A.mono, fontSize: 11, color: A.inkMute }}>{r.id}</span>
                <button onClick={() => setDrawer({ type: 'recent', data: r })} style={{ ...bare, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 600, color: A.ink, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{r.epic}</span>

                <span style={{ fontFamily: A.mono, fontSize: 11, color: A.inkMute, textAlign: 'right' }}>{r.size}</span>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: A.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: A.inkMute, textAlign: 'right' }}>{r.when}</span>
                <AButton kind="quiet" style={{ justifySelf: 'end' }} onClick={() => flash(`Resuming ${r.id} — no slot free, queued`)}>resume</AButton>
              </div>)}

          </ASection>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    {/* session drawer */}
    <ADrawer open={d.type === 'session'} onClose={() => setDrawer(null)} title={d.data && d.data.name} sub={d.data && `${d.data.project} · ${d.data.kind}`}
      footer={<React.Fragment>
        <AButton size="md" onClick={() => { setDrawer(null); flash('Session paused'); }}>Pause</AButton>

    <ADrawer open={newEpic} onClose={() => setNewEpic(false)} title="New epic" sub="pick a project to ground the session"

        <AButton size="md" onClick={() => setNewEpic(false)}>Cancel</AButton>
        <AButton size="md" kind="primary" onClick={() => { setNewEpic(false); flash(`→ ${epicProject} · new epic`); }}>Continue</AButton>

'#fbf1e9' : A.paper, borderRadius: 10, padding: '11px 13px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
          <span style={{ width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: '50%', border: `1.5px solid ${epicProject === p ? A.accent : A.rule}`, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center' }}>{epicProject === p && <span style={{ width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: '50%', background: A.accent }} />}</span>

}

// Variant A — Almanac.
// Paper-warm light theme with a Newsreader serif for display type and Geist
// for UI. Editorial feel — large welcomes, calm column rhythm. Terracotta
// accent only on the active nav item and key CTAs.

const ALMANAC = {
  // Layered cream — page is the lightest, panels slightly warmer.
  paper:   '#f6efe1',
  panel:   '#efe6d3',
  card:    '#fbf6ec',
  edge:    '#e0d3b8',
  rule:    '#d9c9a8',
  ink:     '#2a221a',
  inkSoft: '#5b4a36',
  inkMute: '#8a7a60',
  accent:  '#b85c34',      // terracotta
  accentSoft: '#e8a988',
  sage:    '#6f7d52',
  butter:  '#e4b85a',
  serif:   "'Newsreader', Georgia, serif",
  sans:    "'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif",
  mono:    "'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace",
};

function AlmanacTab({ p, active, onClick }) {
  return (
    <button onClick={onClick} style={{
      appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent',
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
      padding: '6px 14px 7px', borderRadius: '10px 10px 0 0',
      fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 500,
      color: active ? ALMANAC.ink : ALMANAC.inkSoft,
      background: active ? ALMANAC.paper : 'transparent',
      cursor: 'pointer', position: 'relative', top: 1,
      borderBottom: active ? `1px solid ${ALMANAC.paper}` : 'none',
    }}>
      <span style={{
        width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: '50%', background: p.dot,
        boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
      }} />
      {p.label}
    </button>
  );
}

function AlmanacNavItem({ item, active, icon, onClick }) {
  return (
    <button onClick={onClick} style={{
      appearance: 'none', border: 0, cursor: 'pointer',
      width: '100%', textAlign: 'left',
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12,
      padding: '9px 14px', borderRadius: 10, marginBottom: 1,
      background: active ? '#fbf6ec' : 'transparent',
      color: active ? ALMANAC.ink : ALMANAC.inkSoft,
      boxShadow: active ? `inset 0 0 0 1px ${ALMANAC.edge}` : 'none',
      fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: active ? 600 : 500,
      position: 'relative',
    }}>
      {active && <span style={{
        position: 'absolute', left: -10, top: 12, bottom: 12, width: 3,
        background: ALMANAC.accent, borderRadius: 2,
      }} />}
      <span style={{ color: active ? ALMANAC.accent : ALMANAC.inkMute, display: 'inline-flex' }}>
        <SMIcon name={icon} size={17} stroke={1.6} />
      </span>
      {item.label}
    </button>
  );
}

function AlmanacSidebar({ mode, setMode, activeNav, setActiveNav, project }) {
  return (
    <aside style={{
      width: 252, flexShrink: 0,
      background: ALMANAC.panel,
      borderRight: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`,
      display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column',
      fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans,
    }}>
      {/* Project caption */}
      <div style={{ padding: '14px 18px 10px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.rule}` }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 0.6, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
          Project
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 8, marginTop: 4 }}>
          <span style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: '50%', background: project.dot, alignSelf: 'center' }} />
          <span style={{ fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 500, color: ALMANAC.ink }}>{project.label}</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, marginTop: 2, fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono }}>
          ⌥{project.branch}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Nav / Files toggle */}
      <div style={{ padding: '12px 14px 8px', display: 'flex', gap: 4,
        background: 'transparent' }}>
        {['nav','files'].map(k => (
          <button key={k} onClick={() => setMode(k)} style={{
            flex: 1, appearance: 'none', border: 0, cursor: 'pointer',
            padding: '6px 0', borderRadius: 7,
            background: mode === k ? ALMANAC.card : 'transparent',
            boxShadow: mode === k ? `inset 0 0 0 1px ${ALMANAC.edge}` : 'none',
            color: mode === k ? ALMANAC.ink : ALMANAC.inkMute,
            fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 0.3,
          }}>
            {k === 'nav' ? 'Navigate' : 'Files'}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Body */}
      <div style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', padding: '6px 8px 16px' }}>
        {mode === 'nav' ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px 6px', fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: 0.8, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, textTransform: 'uppercase',
              fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
              Workspace
            </div>
            {SM_NAV_WORKSPACE.map(item =>
              <AlmanacNavItem key={item.id} item={item} icon={item.id}
                active={activeNav === item.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveNav(item.id)} />
            )}
            <div style={{ padding: '14px 12px 6px', fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: 0.8, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, textTransform: 'uppercase',
              fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
              Configure
            </div>
            {SM_NAV_CONFIG.map(item =>
              <AlmanacNavItem key={item.id} item={item} icon={item.id}
                active={activeNav === item.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveNav(item.id)} />
            )}
            <div style={{ padding: '14px 12px 6px', fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: 0.8, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, textTransform: 'uppercase',
              fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
              Tools
            </div>
            {SM_NAV_TOOLS.map(item =>
              <AlmanacNavItem key={item.id} item={item} icon={item.id}
                active={activeNav === item.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveNav(item.id)} />
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ paddingTop: 4 }}>
            <div style={{ padding: '6px 12px 8px', fontSize: 12, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono }}>
              ~/Projects/{project.label}
            </div>
            {SM_FILE_TREE.map((item, i) =>
              <SMTreeRow key={i} item={item} mutedColor={ALMANAC.inkMute} accent={ALMANAC.accent} />
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer status — replaces the cryptic bottom bar */}
      <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', borderTop: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.rule}`,
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
        fontSize: 11.5, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft, fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono }}>
        <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', background: ALMANAC.sage }} />
        Claude Max · Opus 4.7
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

function AlmanacWindowFooter() {
  return (
    <div style={{
      height: 30, flexShrink: 0,
      background: ALMANAC.panel, borderTop: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`,
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 16,
      padding: '0 18px', fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono, fontSize: 11.5, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft,
    }}>
      <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
        <span style={{ color: ALMANAC.sage, display: 'inline-flex' }}><SMIcon name="dot" size={12} /></span>
        connected
      </span>
      <span>3 of 5h window used</span>
      <span>184 prompts · $6.42</span>
      <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>v0.12.1</span>
    </div>
  );
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Home screen — friendly orientation
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function AlmanacHome({ project, setActiveNav }) {
  const greeting = (() => {
    const h = new Date().getHours();
    if (h < 5)  return 'Up late';
    if (h < 12) return 'Good morning';
    if (h < 18) return 'Good afternoon';
    return 'Good evening';
  })();

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '32px 40px 28px', fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, color: ALMANAC.ink, maxWidth: 980 }}>
      {/* Hero */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 18, marginBottom: 28 }}>
        <div style={{
          width: 56, height: 56, borderRadius: 14,
          background: ALMANAC.card, border: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`,
          display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center',
          boxShadow: '0 2px 0 #e0d3b8',
        }}>
          <SMMascot size={32} fg={ALMANAC.accent} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft, fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, letterSpacing: 0.2 }}>
            {greeting}, Bilko.
          </div>
          <h1 style={{
            margin: '2px 0 6px', fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif,
            fontSize: 38, fontWeight: 500, lineHeight: 1.1,
            color: ALMANAC.ink, letterSpacing: -0.4, textWrap: 'pretty',
          }}>
            Your <em style={{ color: ALMANAC.accent, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>local cockpit</em> for Claude Code.
          </h1>
          <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 15, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft, maxWidth: 620, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
            Wraps the CLI alongside skills, hooks, MCP servers, and a scheduler that runs jobs against your 5-hour window. Nothing here phones home.
          </p>

          <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 15, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft, maxWidth: 620, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
            Wraps the CLI alongside skills, hooks, MCP servers, and a scheduler that runs jobs against your 5-hour window. Nothing here phones home.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Window + quick actions */}
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.25fr 1fr', gap: 18, marginBottom: 28 }}>
        {/* Billing window card */}
        <div style={{
          background: ALMANAC.card, border: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`,
          borderRadius: 14, padding: '18px 20px',
        }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <span style={{ color: ALMANAC.accent, display: 'inline-flex' }}><SMIcon name="clock" size={16} /></span>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 500 }}>5-hour window</span>
            </div>
            <span style={{ fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono, fontSize: 12, color: ALMANAC.inkMute }}>
              {SM_BILLING_WINDOW.startedAt} → {SM_BILLING_WINDOW.endsAt}
            </span>
          </div>
          {/* progress bar */}
          <div style={{ height: 10, background: ALMANAC.paper, borderRadius: 999, overflow: 'hidden', border: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.rule}` }}>
            <div style={{
              width: `${SM_BILLING_WINDOW.elapsedPct * 100}%`, height: '100%',
              background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${ALMANAC.accent}, ${ALMANAC.accentSoft})`,
            }} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: 12, fontSize: 13, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft }}>
            <span><strong style={{ color: ALMANAC.ink, fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono }}>{SM_BILLING_WINDOW.promptsUsed}</strong> of {SM_BILLING_WINDOW.promptsCap} prompts</span>
            <span><strong style={{ color: ALMANAC.ink, fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono }}>${SM_BILLING_WINDOW.cost}</strong> est. cost</span>
            <span style={{ color: ALMANAC.sage }}>2 h 53 m remaining</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quick actions */}
        <div style={{ background: ALMANAC.card, border: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`, borderRadius: 14, padding: '14px 16px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 500 }}>Quick start</div>
            <button title="Voice (Whisper)" style={{
              appearance: 'none', border: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`, background: ALMANAC.paper,
              width: 30, height: 30, borderRadius: 8, cursor: 'pointer',
              display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', color: ALMANAC.accent,
            }}><SMIcon name="mic" size={15} /></button>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 8 }}>
            {SM_QUICK_ACTIONS.map(a => (
              <button key={a.id} onClick={() => a.id === 'plan' && setActiveNav('plans')} style={{
                appearance: 'none', textAlign: 'left', cursor: 'pointer',
                background: ALMANAC.paper, border: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`,
                borderRadius: 10, padding: '10px 12px',
                fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans,
              }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <span style={{ color: ALMANAC.accent, display: 'inline-flex' }}><SMIcon name={a.icon} size={14} /></span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: ALMANAC.ink }}>{a.label}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, marginTop: 3 }}>{a.hint}</div>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Today's sessions */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 500 }}>
            Recent sessions
          </h2>
          <button onClick={() => setActiveNav('history')} style={{
            appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer',
            fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, fontSize: 13, color: ALMANAC.accent, fontWeight: 500,
          }}>
            See all history →
          </button>
        </div>
        <div style={{ background: ALMANAC.card, border: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`, borderRadius: 14, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          {SM_RECENT_SESSIONS.slice(0, 4).map((s, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{
              display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.4fr 2fr auto auto',
              alignItems: 'center', gap: 16, padding: '12px 18px',
              borderTop: i ? `1px solid ${ALMANAC.rule}` : 'none',
            }}>
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: 600, color: ALMANAC.ink }}>{s.project}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono, marginTop: 1 }}>
                  ⌥{s.branch}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft, fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                "{s.task}"
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                {s.tokens} · {s.ago}
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
                <span style={{
                  fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: 999,
                  background: s.status === 'paused' ? '#f5e3c8' : '#e5ecd8',
                  color: s.status === 'paused' ? '#8a6818' : '#4a5e2e',
                }}>{s.status === 'paused' ? 'paused — resume' : 'finished'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Scheduler peek */}
      <div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 500 }}>
            In the scheduler
          </h2>
          <button onClick={() => setActiveNav('scheduler')} style={{
            appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer',
            fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, fontSize: 13, color: ALMANAC.accent, fontWeight: 500,
          }}>
            Open scheduler →
          </button>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 12 }}>
          {SM_SCHEDULER_QUEUE.map(j => (
            <div key={j.id} style={{
              background: ALMANAC.card, border: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`, borderRadius: 12,
              padding: '12px 14px',
            }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 6 }}>
                <span style={{
                  fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, padding: '2px 7px', borderRadius: 999,
                  background: j.state === 'running' ? ALMANAC.accent : ALMANAC.paper,
                  color: j.state === 'running' ? '#fff' : ALMANAC.inkSoft,
                  border: j.state === 'queued' ? `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}` : 'none',
                }}>{j.state}</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono }}>{j.eta}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 600, color: ALMANAC.ink }}>{j.project}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft, fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: 2 }}>
                "{j.task}"
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Per-section placeholder content — shows that nav works and that the
// "full page" promise of the brief is realized in layout.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function AlmanacSection({ item }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '36px 40px', fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, color: ALMANAC.ink, maxWidth: 980 }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, letterSpacing: 0.8, textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 8 }}>
        {item.label}
      </div>
      <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: ALMANAC.serif, fontSize: 34, fontWeight: 500, color: ALMANAC.ink, lineHeight: 1.1 }}>
        {item.hint}.
      </h1>
      <p style={{ marginTop: 10, fontSize: 14, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft, maxWidth: 560, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
        This section gets a full page to itself — no cryptic toolbar. The detailed UI for{' '}
        <strong style={{ color: ALMANAC.ink }}>{item.label}</strong> goes here.
      </p>

      <div style={{
        marginTop: 22, background: ALMANAC.card, border: `1px dashed ${ALMANAC.rule}`,
        borderRadius: 14, padding: '28px 32px', color: ALMANAC.inkMute, fontSize: 13,
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
      }}>
        <SMIcon name={item.id} size={18} stroke={1.5} />
        Layout slot for {item.label.toLowerCase()}.
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Frame
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Almanac({ width = 1320, height = 860, initialNav = 'home' }) {
  const [project, setProject] = React.useState(SM_PROJECTS[0]);
  const [mode, setMode]       = React.useState('nav');
  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = React.useState(initialNav);

  const sectionItem = [...SM_NAV_WORKSPACE, ...SM_NAV_CONFIG, ...SM_NAV_TOOLS].find(i => i.id === activeNav);

  return (
    <div style={{
      width, height, overflow: 'hidden',
      background: ALMANAC.paper, color: ALMANAC.ink,
      display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column',
      fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, position: 'relative',
      borderRadius: 0,
    }}>
      {/* Title bar with tabs */}
      <div style={{
        height: 44, flexShrink: 0, background: ALMANAC.panel,
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${ALMANAC.edge}`,
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 0, padding: '0 14px',
        position: 'relative',
      }}>
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 14, left: 14 }}>
          <SMTrafficLights size={12} />
        </div>
        <div style={{ width: 86, flexShrink: 0 }} />
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 2, flex: 1 }}>
          {SM_PROJECTS.map(p => (
            <AlmanacTab key={p.id} p={p}
              active={p.id === project.id}
              onClick={() => setProject(p)} />
          ))}
          <button title="New project" style={{
            appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent',
            color: ALMANAC.inkMute, padding: '6px 10px', cursor: 'pointer',
            marginBottom: 2,
          }}>
            <SMIcon name="plus" size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, color: ALMANAC.inkMute, fontSize: 12, fontFamily: ALMANAC.sans, paddingBottom: 12 }}>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: ALMANAC.inkSoft }}>Session Manager</span>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: ALMANAC.mono, fontSize: 11 }}>v0.12.1</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Body */}
      <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', minHeight: 0 }}>
        <AlmanacSidebar
          mode={mode} setMode={setMode}
          activeNav={activeNav} setActiveNav={setActiveNav}
          project={project} />
        <main style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', background: ALMANAC.paper }}>
          {activeNav === 'home'
            ? <AlmanacHome project={project} setActiveNav={setActiveNav} />
            : activeNav === 'subagents' && window.HivePage
            ? <HivePage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'browser' && window.BrowserPage
            ? <BrowserPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'terminal' && window.TerminalPage
            ? <TerminalPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'plans' && window.PlansPage
            ? <PlansPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'tasks' && window.TasksPage
            ? <TasksPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'history' && (window.AnalyticsPage || window.HistoryPage)
            ? (window.AnalyticsPage ? <AnalyticsPage project={project} /> : <HistoryPage project={project} />)
            : activeNav === 'docs' && window.DocEditorPage
            ? <DocEditorPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'projects' && window.ProjectsPage
            ? <ProjectsPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'settings' && window.SettingsPage
            ? <SettingsPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'remote' && window.RemotePage
            ? <RemotePage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'scheduler' && window.SchedulerPage
            ? <SchedulerPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'usage' && window.UsagePage
            ? <UsagePage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'skills' && window.SkillsPage
            ? <SkillsPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'plugins' && window.PluginsPage
            ? <PluginsPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'mcp' && window.McpPage
            ? <McpPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'hooks' && window.HooksPage
            ? <HooksPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'keys' && window.KeybindingsPage
            ? <KeybindingsPage project={project} />
            : activeNav === 'memory' && window.MemoryPage
            ? <MemoryPage project={project} />
            : <AlmanacSection item={sectionItem} />}
        </main>
      </div>

      <AlmanacWindowFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

window.Almanac = Almanac;
window.ALMANAC = ALMANAC;

148	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
149	function SessionSlotCapControl({ slots }: { slots: SlotSnapshot | null }) {
150	  const min = slots?.min ?? 0
151	  const max = slots?.max ?? 10
152	  const total = slots?.total ?? 5
153	  const envOverride = slots?.envOverride ?? false
154	  const [pending, setPending] = useState<number | null>(null)
155	  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
156	  const value = pending ?? total
157	
158	  const commit = (n: number) => {
159	    setPending(n)
160	    setSaving(true)
161	    window.api.schedule.setSessionSlots(n)
162	      .catch(() => { /* Toast is reserved for user-triggered actions; snapshot poll will resync display */ })
163	      .finally(() => { setSaving(false); setPending(null) })
164	  }
165	
166	  return (
167	    <span className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0" title={envOverride ? 'Pinned by SM_SESSION_SLOTS env var' : 'Max concurrent claude -p sessions on this machine (0 pauses new launches)'}>
168	      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-fg-faint">Max slots</span>
169	      <input
170	        type="range"
171	        min={min}
172	        max={max}
173	        step={1}
174	        value={value}
175	        disabled={envOverride || saving}
176	        onChange={(e) => commit(Number(e.target.value))}
177	        className="w-24 accent-accent disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
178	      />
179	      <span className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-fg w-4 text-right">{value}</span>
180	    </span>
181	  )

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Session slot cap control — 0 (pause all new launches) to 10 (max
// allowed), default 5. Shared by ActiveSessionsCard below.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SessionSlotCapControl({ slots }: { slots: SlotSnapshot | null }) {
  const min = slots?.min ?? 0
  const max = slots?.max ?? 10
  const total = slots?.total ?? 5
  const envOverride = slots?.envOverride ?? false
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const value = pending ?? total

  const commit = (n: number) => {
    setPending(n)
    setSaving(true)
    window.api.schedule.setSessionSlots(n)
      .catch(() => { /* Toast is reserved for user-triggered actions; snapshot poll will resync display */ })
      .finally(() => { setSaving(false); setPending(null) })
  }

  return (
    <span className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0" title={envOverride ? 'Pinned by SM_SESSION_SLOTS env var' : 'Max concurrent claude -p sessions on this machine (0 pauses new launches)'}>
      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-fg-faint">Max slots</span>
      <input
        type="range"
        min={min}
        max={max}
        step={1}
        value={value}
        disabled={envOverride || saving}
        onChange={(e) => commit(Number(e.target.value))}
        className="w-24 accent-accent disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
      />
      <span className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-fg w-4 text-right">{value}</span>
    </span>
  )
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Epic hydration — active + archived PromptSessions for every known cwd, so
// Active/Recent sessions can resolve Epic titles. Mirrors EpicsWorkspace's
// knownCwds hydrate loop.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function useHydrateKnownEpics(): void {
  const { rows, enriched } = useKnownProjects()
  const knownCwdsKey = useMemo(
    () => rows.map((r) => enriched[r.encoded]?.cwd ?? r.displayPath).join('\n'),
    [rows, enriched],
  )
  useEffect(() => {
    for (const cwd of knownCwdsKey ? knownCwdsKey.split('\n') : []) {
      void usePromptSessions.getState().hydrate(cwd)
      void usePromptSessions.getState().hydrateArchived(cwd)
    }
  }, [knownCwdsKey])
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Recent sessions
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface RecentRow {
  sessionId: string
  projectEncoded: string
  path: string
  mtimeMs: number
  sizeBytes: number
}

function useRecentSessions(limit = 4): { rows: RecentRow[]; loading: boolean } {
  const home = useHomeDir()
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<RecentRow[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!home) return
    let cancelled = false
    ;(async () => {
      setLoading(true)
      try {
        const projects = await window.api.config.listDir(`${home}/.claude/projects`, { dirsOnly: true })
        const all: RecentRow[] = []
        for (const proj of projects.entries as DirEntry[]) {
          if (cancelled) return
          const files = await window.api.config.listDir(proj.path, { filesOnly: true })
          for (const f of files.entries as DirEntry[]) {
            if (!f.name.endsWith('.jsonl')) continue
            all.push({
              sessionId: f.name.replace(/\.jsonl$/, ''),
              projectEncoded: proj.name,
              path: f.path,
              mtimeMs: f.mtimeMs,
              sizeBytes: f.size,
            })
          }
        }
        all.sort((a, b) => b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs)
        if (!cancelled) setRows(all.slice(0, limit))
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[Home] recent-sessions scan failed:', e)
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false)
      }
    })()
    return () => { cancelled = true }
  }, [home, limit])
  return { rows, loading }
}

          const epicTitle = recentSessionEpicTitle(r.sessionId, sessions)
          return (
            <div
              key={r.path}
              className="grid items-center gap-3.5 px-[18px] py-[11px]"
              style={{ gridTemplateColumns: RECENT_SESSIONS_GRID, borderTop: i ? '1px solid #d9c9a8' : 'none' }}
            >
              <span className="text-[11.5px] text-fg-faint font-mono truncate">{r.sessionId.slice(0, 8)}</span>
              <span className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-fg truncate" title={r.projectEncoded}>
                {decodeProject(r.projectEncoded)}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[12.5px] text-fg-dim truncate">{epicTitle ?? '—'}</span>
              <span className="text-[11.5px] text-fg-faint font-mono text-right">
                {Math.round(r.sizeBytes / 1024)}k
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-fg-faint font-mono text-right">{relativeTime(r.mtimeMs)}</span>
              <button
                onClick={() => resume(r)}
                className="justify-self-end text-[12px] font-semibold px-[11px] py-[5px] rounded-lg text-sage bg-[#e5ecd8] hover:brightness-95 transition-[filter]"
                title={`Resume ${r.sessionId.slice(0, 8)}…`}
              >
                resume
              </button>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

function decodeProject(encoded: string): string {
  // Show the last path segment for compactness. Reuses useKnownProjects'
  // candidatePath so the encoded→path decode logic has one implementation.
  const parts = candidatePath(encoded).split('/').filter(Boolean)
  return parts.length > 0 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : encoded
}

function relativeTime(ms: number): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - ms
  if (diff < 60_000) return 'just now'
  if (diff < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60_000)}m ago`
  if (diff < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3_600_000)}h ago`
  return `${Math.floor(diff / 86_400_000)}d ago`
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Active sessions — the machine-wide `claude -p` session-slot pool
// (lib/sessionSlots.cjs) joined against running scheduler jobs / chat runs.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type SlotSnapshot = {
  total: number; inUse: number; holders: { owner: string; at: string }[]
  min: number; max: number; default: number; envOverride: boolean
}

function ActiveSessionsCard({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate?: (k: NavKey) => void }) {
  const [slots, setSlots] = useState<SlotSnapshot | null>(null)
  const jobs = useScheduleState((s) => s.snapshot?.jobs) ?? EMPTY_JOBS
  const chats = useChatSignals()
  const sessions = usePromptSessions((s) => s.sessions)

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true
    const poll = () => {
      window.api.schedule.sessionSlots()
        .then((s) => { if (alive) setSlots(s) })
        .catch(() => { /* pool surface is diagnostic-only */ })
    }
    poll()
    const id = setInterval(poll, 5000)
    return () => { alive = false; clearInterval(id) }
  }, [])

  const total = slots?.total ?? 5
  const inUse = slots?.inUse ?? 0
  const runningJobs = useMemo(() => jobs.filter((j) => j.status === 'running'), [jobs])
  const rows = useMemo(
    () => activeSessionRows(slots?.holders ?? [], runningJobs, chats, sessions),
    [slots, runningJobs, chats, sessions],
  )

  const open = (row: ReturnType<typeof activeSessionRows>[number]) => {
    if (row.openTarget === 'scheduler') { onNavigate?.('scheduler'); return }
    if (row.openTarget === 'terminal' && row.epicId) {
      setPendingPromptSessionId(row.epicId)
      onNavigate?.('terminal')
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="mb-6">
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-3">
        <h2 className="m-0 font-serif text-[22px] font-medium">Active sessions</h2>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <span className="font-mono text-[12px] text-fg-faint">{inUse} of {total} slots in use</span>
          <SessionSlotCapControl slots={slots} />
        </span>
      </div>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-[13px] text-fg-faint py-1">No headless Claude sessions running.</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <div
              key={row.owner}
              className="bg-bg-hi border border-line rounded-[13px] px-4 py-[13px] grid items-center gap-3.5"
              style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(0,1fr) auto' }}
            >
              <span className="min-w-0">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-accent shrink-0" />
                  <span className="font-mono text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-fg truncate">{row.owner}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10.5px] text-fg-faint shrink-0">{row.kind}</span>
                </span>
                {(row.project || row.epicTitle) && (
                  <span className="block text-[12px] text-fg-faint truncate">
                    {[row.project, row.epicTitle ? `Epic · ${row.epicTitle}` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
                  </span>
                )}
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-3.5 shrink-0">
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-fg-faint">{relativeTime(new Date(row.at).getTime())}</span>
                {row.openTarget && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => open(row)}
                    className="border border-line bg-bg rounded-lg px-[11px] py-[5px] text-[12px] font-semibold text-fg-dim hover:bg-bg/60 transition-colors"
                  >
                    Open
                  </button>
                )}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  )
}

// Pure join helpers for the Global Home "Active sessions" + "Recent sessions"
// sections. Kept dependency-free (plain shapes, no store imports) so they are
// unit-testable without mocking zustand — same shape as homeProjectRows.ts.
import { projectNameFromCwd } from './homeProjectRows'

export interface SlotHolderLite {
  owner: string
  at: string
}

export interface ScheduleJobLite {
  slug: string
  cwd: string | null
  sourcePromptId?: string | null
}

export interface ChatSignalLite {
  running: boolean
}

export interface EpicLite {
  cwd: string
  goalText: string
  claudeSessionId?: string
}

export type ActiveSessionKind = 'scheduler job' | 'chat run' | 'session'
export type ActiveSessionOpenTarget = 'scheduler' | 'terminal' | null

export interface ActiveSessionRow {
  owner: string
  kind: ActiveSessionKind
  at: string
  project: string | null
  epicTitle: string | null
  openTarget: ActiveSessionOpenTarget
  epicId: string | null
}

function unresolvedRow(holder: SlotHolderLite): ActiveSessionRow {
  return {
    owner: holder.owner,
    kind: 'session',
    at: holder.at,
    project: null,
    epicTitle: null,
    openTarget: null,
    epicId: null,
  }
}

/**
 * Joins `sessionSlots().holders` against running scheduler jobs (owner
 * `scheduler:<slug>`) and running chat runs (owner `chat:<epicId>`, keyed by
 * Epic id) to produce display rows for the Active sessions section. A holder
 * whose owner matches neither still renders (owner + started-ago only).
 */
export function activeSessionRows(
  holders: SlotHolderLite[],
  jobs: ScheduleJobLite[],
  chats: Record<string, ChatSignalLite>,
  sessions: Record<string, EpicLite>,
): ActiveSessionRow[] {
  return holders.map((holder) => {
    const owner = holder.owner
    if (owner.startsWith('scheduler:')) {
      const slug = owner.slice('scheduler:'.length)
      const job = jobs.find((j) => j.slug === slug)
      if (!job) return unresolvedRow(holder)
      const epicId = job.sourcePromptId ?? null
      const epic = epicId ? sessions[epicId] : undefined
      return {
        owner,
        kind: 'scheduler job',
        at: holder.at,
        project: job.cwd ? projectNameFromCwd(job.cwd) : null,
        epicTitle: epic?.goalText ?? null,
        openTarget: 'scheduler',
        epicId: null,
      }
    }
    if (owner.startsWith('chat:')) {
      const epicId = owner.slice('chat:'.length)
      const chat = chats[epicId]
      const epic = sessions[epicId]
      if (!chat?.running || !epic) return unresolvedRow(holder)
      return {
        owner,
        kind: 'chat run',
        at: holder.at,
        project: projectNameFromCwd(epic.cwd),
        epicTitle: epic.goalText,
        openTarget: 'terminal',
        epicId,
      }
    }
    return unresolvedRow(holder)
  })
}

/**
 * Resolves the Epic title for a Recent-sessions row by matching the
 * transcript's sessionId against every known PromptSession's
 * claudeSessionId — `sessions` must include both active and archived Epics
 * (usePromptSessions merges both into one map once hydrated). Returns null
 * for plain terminal sessions with no matching Epic.
 */
export function recentSessionEpicTitle(
  sessionId: string,
  sessions: Record<string, EpicLite>,
): string | null {
  for (const epicId of Object.keys(sessions)) {
    if (sessions[epicId].claudeSessionId === sessionId) return sessions[epicId].goalText
  }
  return null
}

// Pure row-model for the Global Home Projects card. Joins known-project rows
// against running chats (keyed by Epic id) via each Epic's cwd, so "N live"
// reflects real in-flight work rather than just recency. Kept dependency-free
// (plain shapes, no store imports) so it is unit-testable without mocking
// zustand.
import type { ProjectRow, EnrichmentState } from './useKnownProjects'

export interface ChatSignalLite {
  running: boolean
}

export interface EpicSessionLite {
  cwd: string
}

export interface HomeProjectRow {
  encoded: string
  name: string
  cwd: string
  dotSeed: string
  liveCount: number
  lastActivityMs: number
}

export function projectNameFromCwd(cwd: string): string {
  const parts = cwd.split('/').filter(Boolean)
  return parts.length > 0 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : cwd
}

/**
 * Builds display rows for the Projects card from `useKnownProjects` rows,
 * enrichment (resolved cwd per encoded project), running chats keyed by Epic
 * id, and Epic sessions keyed by Epic id (for cwd lookup). A project's
 * liveCount is the count of running chats whose Epic's cwd matches.
 */
export function buildHomeProjectRows(
  rows: ProjectRow[],
  enriched: Record<string, EnrichmentState | undefined>,
  chats: Record<string, ChatSignalLite>,
  sessions: Record<string, EpicSessionLite>,
): HomeProjectRow[] {
  const liveByCwd = new Map<string, number>()
  for (const epicId of Object.keys(chats)) {
    if (!chats[epicId]?.running) continue
    const cwd = sessions[epicId]?.cwd
    if (!cwd) continue
    liveByCwd.set(cwd, (liveByCwd.get(cwd) ?? 0) + 1)
  }

  return rows.map((row) => {
    const cwd = enriched[row.encoded]?.cwd ?? row.displayPath
    return {
      encoded: row.encoded,
      name: projectNameFromCwd(cwd),
      cwd,
      dotSeed: cwd,
      liveCount: liveByCwd.get(cwd) ?? 0,
      lastActivityMs: row.lastSession,
    }
  })

/**
 * Resolves the Epic title for a Recent-sessions row by matching the
 * transcript's sessionId against every known PromptSession's
 * claudeSessionId — `sessions` must include both active and archived Epics
 * (usePromptSessions merges both into one map once hydrated). Returns null
 * for plain terminal sessions with no matching Epic.
 */
export function recentSessionEpicTitle(
  sessionId: string,
  sessions: Record<string, EpicLite>,
): string | null {
  for (const epicId of Object.keys(sessions)) {
    if (sessions[epicId].claudeSessionId === sessionId) return sessions[epicId].goalText
  }
  return null
}

// Pure row-model for the Global Home Projects card. Joins known-project rows
// against running chats (keyed by Epic id) via each Epic's cwd, so "N live"
// reflects real in-flight work rather than just recency. Kept dependency-free
// (plain shapes, no store imports) so it is unit-testable without mocking
// zustand.
import type { ProjectRow, EnrichmentState } from './useKnownProjects'

export interface ChatSignalLite {
  running: boolean
}

export interface EpicSessionLite {
  cwd: string
}

export interface HomeProjectRow {
  encoded: string
  name: string
  cwd: string
  dotSeed: string
  liveCount: number
  lastActivityMs: number
}

export function projectNameFromCwd(cwd: string): string {
  const parts = cwd.split('/').filter(Boolean)
  return parts.length > 0 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : cwd
}

/**
 * Builds display rows for the Projects card from `useKnownProjects` rows,
 * enrichment (resolved cwd per encoded project), running chats keyed by Epic
 * id, and Epic sessions keyed by Epic id (for cwd lookup). A project's
 * liveCount is the count of running chats whose Epic's cwd matches.
 */
export function buildHomeProjectRows(
  rows: ProjectRow[],
  enriched: Record<string, EnrichmentState | undefined>,
  chats: Record<string, ChatSignalLite>,
  sessions: Record<string, EpicSessionLite>,
): HomeProjectRow[] {
  const liveByCwd = new Map<string, number>()
  for (const epicId of Object.keys(chats)) {
    if (!chats[epicId]?.running) continue
    const cwd = sessions[epicId]?.cwd
    if (!cwd) continue
    liveByCwd.set(cwd, (liveByCwd.get(cwd) ?? 0) + 1)
  }

  return rows.map((row) => {
    const cwd = enriched[row.encoded]?.cwd ?? row.displayPath
    return {
      encoded: row.encoded,
      name: projectNameFromCwd(cwd),
      cwd,
      dotSeed: cwd,
      liveCount: liveByCwd.get(cwd) ?? 0,
      lastActivityMs: row.lastSession,
    }
  })

 * EpicApprovalBar — the human gate in front of a 'proposed' Epic.
 *
 * This is what replaced the feedback-folder intake. An agent that wants work
 * done files an Epic in status 'proposed' instead of writing a markdown file
 * into session-manager-operations/feedback/ for a separate skill to parse,
 * triage and re-queue later. Nothing runs and nothing is spent until someone
 * presses Approve here, at which point the Epic's own goalText becomes the
 * opening prompt of its session — the same start path a hand-created Epic
 * takes (lib/epicIntake), so there is one way an Epic begins, not two.
 *
 * Discard archives the proposal (markCompleted) rather than deleting it, so a
 * rejected proposal stays auditable instead of vanishing.
 */
import { useState } from 'react'
import { usePromptSessions, type PromptSession } from '../../state/promptSessions'
import { useChat } from '../../state/chat'
import { toast } from '../../state/toast'
import { EpicKindTag } from './epic-primitives'

export function EpicApprovalBar({ epic }: { epic: PromptSession }) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  const onApprove = () => {
    if (busy) return
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const approved = usePromptSessions.getState().approveProposed(epic.id, 'EpicApprovalBar')
      if (!approved) {
        toast.error('This Epic is no longer awaiting approval.')
        return
      }
      useChat.getState().send({
        tabId: approved.id,
        sessionId: approved.claudeSessionId,
        cwd: approved.cwd,
        prompt: approved.openingPrompt || approved.goalText,
      })
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  const onDiscard = () => {
    if (busy) return
    setBusy(true)
    void usePromptSessions
      .getState()
      .markCompleted(epic.id, 'EpicApprovalBar discard')
      .catch((err) => toast.error(`Could not discard: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`))
      .finally(() => setBusy(false))
  }

  return (
    <div data-testid="epic-approval-bar" className="border-t border-butter/40 bg-butter/10 px-[22px] py-3">
      <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="font-mono text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-fg-dim">
          proposed — not started
        </span>
        <EpicKindTag kind={epic.tag} small />
      </div>
      <p className="mb-2.5 max-w-[760px] text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-fg-dim">
        Filed for you to decide on. Nothing has run and nothing has been spent. Approving sends the objective
        above as this Epic's first prompt.
      </p>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-testid="epic-approve"
          onClick={onApprove}
          disabled={busy}
          className="rounded-md bg-accent px-4 py-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-bg-hi hover:bg-accent-dark disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          Approve & start
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-testid="epic-discard"
          onClick={onDiscard}
          disabled={busy}
          className="rounded-md border border-line bg-bg-hi px-3.5 py-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-fg-dim hover:bg-bg-elev disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          Discard
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

 */

{"parentUuid":"f08317be-da3b-493c-874f-70ef46184fa6","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CderLF5dtztKxZygVKjYb","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01DSnnmFDmkfUxQYttsoBFrD","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/bilko/Projects/session-manager/src/renderer/lib/homeNeedsYou.ts","content":"// Pure row-model for the Global Home "Needs you" section (Home Screen A
// design). Joins three REAL signals that already gate on a human somewhere
// in the app — nothing here is fabricated:
//   - a `proposed` Epic (the human gate that replaced the feedback folder —
//     see EpicApprovalBar.tsx)
//   - a chat ticket in `needs-input` (the composer's stop-signal protocol)
//   - a scheduler job in `failed` / `needs_review` (the queue's own verdict)
// Kept dependency-free (plain shapes, no store imports) so it is
// unit-testable without mocking zustand — same shape as homeSessionRows.ts.
import { projectNameFromCwd } from './homeProjectRows'

export interface ProposedEpicLite {
  id: string
  cwd: string
  goalText: string
  tag?: string
}

export interface TicketLite {
  id: string
  tabId: string
  cwd: string
  status: string
  text: string
}

export interface ScheduleJobLite {
  slug: string
  title: string
  cwd: string | null
  status: string
  error: string | null
}

export type NeedsYouKind = 'proposed-epic' | 'needs-input' | 'job-failed'

export interface NeedsYouRow {
  id: string
  kind: NeedsYouKind
  label: string
  detail: string
  meta: string
  project: string | null
  /** Epic id for 'proposed-epic' / 'needs-input' rows (drives Approve/Open actions). */
  epicId: string | null
  /** Job slug for 'job-failed' rows (drives Retry). */
  jobSlug: string | null
}

/**
 * Builds the unified "needs you" list. `sessions` must already be scoped to
 * every hydrated Epic (active + archived merge, same map Home's other cards
 * read) — only `status === 'proposed'` entries surface here since archived
 * Epics are 'completed'. `chats` keys on Epic id (== tabId); only chats
 * whose most recent ticket is 'needs-input' surface. `jobs` is the
 * scheduler snapshot; only 'failed' / 'needs_review' surface.
 */
export function buildNeedsYouRows(
  sessions: Record<string, ProposedEpicLite>,
  chats: Record<string, { ticketHistory?: TicketLite[] }>,
  jobs: ScheduleJobLite[],
): NeedsYouRow[] {
  const rows: NeedsYouRow[] = []

  for (const id of Object.keys(sessions)) {
    const s = sessions[id]
    rows.push({
      id: `proposed:${id}`,
      kind: 'proposed-epic',
      label: 'Proposed Epic — awaiting approval',
      detail: s.goalText,
      meta: s.tag ? `tag: ${s.tag}` : 'Filed for you to decide on. Nothing has run.',
      project: projectNameFromCwd(s.cwd),
      epicId: id,
      jobSlug: null,
    })
  }

  for (const epicId of Object.keys(chats)) {
    const history = chats[epicId]?.ticketHistory ?? []
    const last = history[history.length - 1]
    if (!last || last.status !== 'needs-input') continue
    rows.push({
      id: `needs-input:${last.id}`,
      kind: 'needs-input',
      label: 'Session is asking a question',
      detail: last.text,
      meta: 'Stopped mid-run, waiting on your reply.',
      project: projectNameFromCwd(last.cwd),
      epicId,
      jobSlug: null,
    })
  }

  for (const job of jobs) {
    if (job.status !== 'failed' && job.status !== 'needs_review') continue
    rows.push({
      id: `job:${job.slug}`,
      kind: 'job-failed',
      label: job.status === 'failed' ? 'Scheduler job failed' : 'Scheduler job needs review',
      detail: job.title || job.slug,
      meta: job.error ?? 'No error detail recorded.',
      project: job.cwd ? projectNameFromCwd(job.cwd) : null,
      epicId: null,
      jobSlug: job.slug,
    })
  }

  return rows

// design). Joins three REAL signals that already gate on a human somewhere
// in the app — nothing here is fabricated:
//   - a `proposed` Epic (the human gate that replaced the feedback folder —
//     see EpicApprovalBar.tsx)
//   - a chat ticket in `needs-input` (the composer's stop-signal protocol)
//   - a scheduler job in `failed` / `needs_review` (the queue's own verdict)
// Kept dependency-free (plain shapes, no store imports) so it is
// unit-testable without mocking zustand — same shape as homeSessionRows.ts.
import { projectNameFromCwd } from './homeProjectRows'

export interface ProposedEpicLite {
  id: string
  cwd: string
  goalText: string
  tag?: string
}

export interface TicketLite {
  id: string
  tabId: string
  cwd: string
  status: string
  text: string
}

export interface ScheduleJobLite {
  slug: string
  title: string
  cwd: string | null
  status: string
  error: string | null
}

export type NeedsYouKind = 'proposed-epic' | 'needs-input' | 'job-failed'

export interface NeedsYouRow {
  id: string
  kind: NeedsYouKind
  label: string
  detail: string
  meta: string
  project: string | null
  /** Epic id for 'proposed-epic' / 'needs-input' rows (drives Approve/Open actions). */
  epicId: string | null
  /** Job slug for 'job-failed' rows (drives Retry). */
  jobSlug: string | null
}

/**
 * Builds the unified "needs you" list. `sessions` must already be scoped to
 * every hydrated Epic (active + archived merge, same map Home's other cards
 * read) — only `status === 'proposed'` entries surface here since archived
 * Epics are 'completed'. `chats` keys on Epic id (== tabId); only chats
 * whose most recent ticket is 'needs-input' surface. `jobs` is the
 * scheduler snapshot; only 'failed' / 'needs_review' surface.
 */
export function buildNeedsYouRows(
  sessions: Record<string, ProposedEpicLite>,
  chats: Record<string, { ticketHistory?: TicketLite[] }>,
  jobs: ScheduleJobLite[],
): NeedsYouRow[] {
  const rows: NeedsYouRow[] = []

  for (const id of Object.keys(sessions)) {
    const s = sessions[id]
    rows.push({
      id: `proposed:${id}`,
      kind: 'proposed-epic',
      label: 'Proposed Epic — awaiting approval',
      detail: s.goalText,
      meta: s.tag ? `tag: ${s.tag}` : 'Filed for you to decide on. Nothing has run.',
      project: projectNameFromCwd(s.cwd),
      epicId: id,
      jobSlug: null,
    })
  }

  for (const epicId of Object.keys(chats)) {
    const history = chats[epicId]?.ticketHistory ?? []
    const last = history[history.length - 1]
    if (!last || last.status !== 'needs-input') continue
    rows.push({
      id: `needs-input:${last.id}`,
      kind: 'needs-input',
      label: 'Session is asking a question',
      detail: last.text,
      meta: 'Stopped mid-run, waiting on your reply.',
      project: projectNameFromCwd(last.cwd),
      epicId,
      jobSlug: null,
    })
  }

  for (const job of jobs) {
    if (job.status !== 'failed' && job.status !== 'needs_review') continue
    rows.push({
      id: `job:${job.slug}`,
      kind: 'job-failed',
      label: job.status === 'failed' ? 'Scheduler job failed' : 'Scheduler job needs review',
      detail: job.title || job.slug,
      meta: job.error ?? 'No error detail recorded.',
      project: job.cwd ? projectNameFromCwd(job.cwd) : null,
      epicId: null,
      jobSlug: job.slug,
    })
  }

  return rows
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Needs you section — expandable rows, one card per real signal.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function NeedsYouSection({ rows, onNavigate }: { rows: NeedsYouRow[]; onNavigate?: (k: NavKey) => void }) {
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const approve = (row: NeedsYouRow) => {
    if (!row.epicId || busyId) return
    setBusyId(row.id)
    try {
      const approved = usePromptSessions.getState().approveProposed(row.epicId, 'Home needs-you')
      if (!approved) {
        toast.error('This Epic is no longer awaiting approval.')
        return
      }
      useChat.getState().send({
        tabId: approved.id,
        sessionId: approved.claudeSessionId,
        cwd: approved.cwd,
        prompt: approved.openingPrompt || approved.goalText,
      })
      toast.info('Epic approved and started.')
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null)
      setOpenId(null)
    }
  }

  const discard = (row: NeedsYouRow) => {
    if (!row.epicId || busyId) return
    setBusyId(row.id)
    void usePromptSessions
      .getState()
      .markCompleted(row.epicId, 'Home needs-you discard')
      .catch((err) => toast.error(`Could not discard: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`))
      .finally(() => { setBusyId(null); setOpenId(null) })
  }

  const openChat = (row: NeedsYouRow) => {
    if (!row.epicId) return
    setPendingPromptSessionId(row.epicId)
    onNavigate?.('terminal')
  }

  const retryJob = (row: NeedsYouRow) => {
    if (!row.jobSlug || busyId) return
    setBusyId(row.id)
    window.api.schedule
      .resetJob(row.jobSlug)
      .then((r) => { if (!r.ok) toast.error(r.error ?? 'Could not reset job.'); else toast.info(`${row.jobSlug} reset to pending.`) })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)))
      .finally(() => { setBusyId(null); setOpenId(null) })
  }

  return (
    <section id="home-needs-you" className="mb-6 scroll-mt-4">
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-3">
        <h2 className="m-0 font-serif text-[22px] font-medium">Needs you</h2>
        <span className="font-mono text-[12px] text-fg-faint">{rows.length ? `${rows.length} open` : 'all clear'}</span>
      </div>
      {rows.length === 0 && (
        <div className="bg-bg-hi border border-line rounded-[11px] px-4 py-[18px] text-center text-[13px] text-fg-faint">
          Nothing waiting on you. Proposed Epics, mid-run questions, and failed jobs will surface here.
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="grid gap-[7px]">
        {rows.map((row) => {
          const open = openId === row.id
          const tone = row.kind === 'job-failed' ? 'bg-accent' : row.kind === 'needs-input' ? 'bg-honey' : 'bg-sage'
          return (
            <div key={row.id} className={`border rounded-[11px] overflow-hidden ${open ? 'bg-bg-hi border-line' : 'bg-bg border-line/60'}`}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setOpenId(open ? null : row.id)}
                className="w-full grid items-center gap-2.5 px-[13px] py-[10px] text-left"
                style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '6px minmax(0,1fr) auto' }}
              >
                <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${tone}`} />
                <span className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="block text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-fg">{row.label}</span>
                  <span className="block text-[11.5px] text-fg-faint truncate">
                    {row.project ? `${row.project} · ` : ''}{row.detail}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-fg-faint">{open ? '▴' : '▾'}</span>
              </button>
              {open && (
                <div className="border-t border-line px-[13px] pt-[11px] pb-3 grid gap-2.5">
                  <div className="text-[12.5px] text-fg-dim leading-relaxed">{row.meta}</div>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    {row.kind === 'proposed-epic' && (
                      <>
                        <NeedsButton onClick={() => approve(row)} disabled={busyId === row.id}>Approve & start</NeedsButton>
                        <NeedsButton quiet onClick={() => discard(row)} disabled={busyId === row.id}>Discard</NeedsButton>
                      </>
                    )}
                    {row.kind === 'needs-input' && (
                      <NeedsButton onClick={() => openChat(row)}>Open session</NeedsButton>
                    )}
                    {row.kind === 'job-failed' && (
                      <>
                        <NeedsButton onClick={() => retryJob(row)} disabled={busyId === row.id}>Retry now</NeedsButton>
                        <NeedsButton quiet onClick={() => onNavigate?.('scheduler')}>View in Scheduler</NeedsButton>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

function NeedsButton({
  children,
  onClick,
  disabled,
  quiet,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
  onClick: () => void
  disabled?: boolean
  quiet?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={
        quiet
          ? 'rounded-md border border-line bg-bg px-3 py-[5px] text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-fg-dim hover:bg-bg-elev disabled:opacity-50'
          : 'rounded-md bg-accent text-bg-hi px-3 py-[5px] text-[11.5px] font-semibold hover:bg-accent-dark disabled:opacity-50'
      }
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  )
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Queued — pending scheduler jobs across all known projects, FIFO order.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function QueuedCard({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate?: (k: NavKey) => void }) {
  const jobs = useScheduleState((s) => s.snapshot?.jobs) ?? EMPTY_JOBS
  const pending = useMemo(
    () => jobs.filter((j) => j.status === 'pending').slice(0, 4),
    [jobs],
  )
  return (
    <button
      onClick={() => onNavigate?.('scheduler')}
      className="text-left bg-bg-hi border border-line rounded-[14px] px-4 py-[14px]"
    >
      <div className="font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-fg-faint mb-2.5">
        Queued
      </div>
      {pending.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-[13px] text-fg-faint py-1">Nothing pending.</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2.5">
          {pending.map((q) => (
            <div key={q.slug}>
              <div className="font-mono text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-fg truncate">{q.title || q.slug}</div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-fg-faint truncate">
                {q.cwd ? projectNameFromCwdLocal(q.cwd) : '—'}
                {q.estimateMinutes != null ? ` · ~${q.estimateMinutes}m` : ''}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </button>
  )
}

function projectNameFromCwdLocal(cwd: string): string {
  const parts = cwd.split('/').filter(Boolean)
  return parts.length > 0 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : cwd
